title: Acylindrical Hyperbolicity and Pure Conjugating Automorphisms in Graph Products of Groups
summary: We study graph products of groups over defining graphs of arbitrary cardinality from two closely related viewpoints. First, we characterize acylindrical hyperbolicity. If the defining graph is irreducible, has at least two vertices, and has a finite star base, then every parabolically full subgroup is either virtually cyclic or acylindrically hyperbolic. For vertex-full subgroups the finite star base condition is also necessary.
